channel.title: Vision Field Notes
channel.description: Practical computer vision and edge AI, from someone who runs it in production.

item.title: mAP, Precision and Recall: How to Read Detection Results
item.description: Learn how to read precision, recall, mAP50 and mAP50-95 in object detection results, and which metric matters most for your own use case and camera setup.

item.title: YOLOv5 vs YOLOv8 vs YOLO11: Which Should You Use?
item.description: YOLOv5 vs YOLOv8 vs YOLO11 compared in practice: workflow, accuracy and speed trade-offs, export support and licence, plus a simple way to decide.

item.title: What Is YOLO? Object Detection Explained Without the Math
item.description: What is YOLO? A plain explanation of how this object detection model finds objects in a single pass, what its output means, and where it fits in a project.

item.title: Train YOLO on a Custom Dataset: A Step-by-Step Guide
item.description: Train YOLO on a custom dataset with Ultralytics: folder layout, data.yaml, the training command, reading results and the first improvements to try.

item.title: Running YOLO on a Raspberry Pi 5: What to Expect
item.description: Running YOLO on a Raspberry Pi 5: setup, model choices, export formats, thread tuning and realistic expectations, with a way to measure speed yourself.

item.title: Reducing False Alarms in Production Video Analytics
item.description: Cut false alarms in production video analytics with post-processing, temporal filtering, masks, per-camera tuning and monitoring for data drift over time.

item.title: Reading RTSP Streams with OpenCV and FFmpeg
item.description: How to read an RTSP stream with OpenCV and FFmpeg: opening the URL, controlling buffering and latency, TCP vs UDP, and fixes for the most common errors.

item.title: Raspberry Pi vs Jetson Orin Nano for Object Detection
item.description: Raspberry Pi vs Jetson Orin Nano for object detection: how GPU, software stack, power, price and ecosystem should decide which board fits your project.

item.title: People Counting with Line Crossing: A Practical Tutorial
item.description: Build a people counter with line crossing: use tracks, check which side of a line a point is on, count direction, avoid double counting and validate the result.

item.title: IoU and Non-Maximum Suppression, Explained with Examples
item.description: Intersection over Union and non-maximum suppression explained step by step, with worked examples, code, and typical IoU and NMS threshold choices for detectors.

item.title: How Many Images Do You Need to Train an Object Detector?
item.description: How many images to train an object detector? Realistic dataset sizes, how to know when to stop collecting, and ways to get more from a small dataset.

item.title: Freelancing in Computer Vision: Finding and Winning the First Jobs
item.description: How to start freelancing in computer vision: positioning, scoping projects, choosing a pricing model, writing proposals and avoiding low-value work.

item.title: Export YOLO to ONNX and Run It with ONNX Runtime
item.description: Export a YOLO model to ONNX with Ultralytics and run it on CPU with ONNX Runtime, including pre-processing, output decoding and NMS differences.

item.title: Computer Vision Engineer Roadmap: What to Learn and in What Order
item.description: A realistic computer vision engineer roadmap from Python and OpenCV to training detectors, edge deployment and video analytics, with projects for each stage.

item.title: Annotation Mistakes That Quietly Ruin Your Model
item.description: Common object detection annotation mistakes, from loose boxes to missing labels and inconsistent classes, and a practical way to audit and fix your dataset.
